content.value: An assignment replaces a variable with the value of an expression of a compatible type. Evaluate the right-hand side using current values before storing the result. Program input is data supplied to an algorithm; in a method, it can arrive through parameters or a returning method call. Keyboard Scanner input is extra Java practice, not required AP CSA content. File input is taught in topic 4.6.

The output is 3 then 5. original holds the value copied before tickets changed. A local variable must be initialized before use. Assignment is not an algebraic equation: tickets = tickets + 2 updates state rather than expressing equality.
Practice: trace the example by hand, change one input, and explain how the result changes. Check an empty or boundary case when the preconditions allow it.
